data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian language, Ilqis means 'handsome' and 'brave'. In Muslim culture, this name symbolizes physical beauty and inner courage. The name Ilqis carries the meaning “Handsome, Brave” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ilqis usually hope their child will grow to embody handsome, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
